reasons.text: The label photo is legible and shows model 6L-PC, which is on the recalled list, so the model is confirmed.
No other claim shares a photo, address, email, serial, or payout account with this one.

The purchase date of 2019-06-14 is inside the sale window, but the retailer 'Corner Hardware Co' is not ALDI. Under the policy, a store not on the list is not denied; the claimant must provide proof of ownership.
The destruction photo does not show a product or a cut unplugged power cord, so it does not show the destruction the recall requires. A new destruction photo is needed.
The serial check was skipped and the typed serial was not used for a decision; the claim is not denied on serial grounds.

input.question_for_claimant: Please send (1) proof of ownership for this cooker, such as a receipt or other document showing your purchase from Corner Hardware Co on or around 2019-06-14, or a note explaining how you came to own it if it was secondhand or a gift; and (2) a new photo showing the unplugged power cord cut through, with the cooker visible in the photo.
